source: RMC-BestFit/src/RMC.BestFit.Tests/DataFrame/PlottingPositionTests.cs (v2.0.0, ARRANGE2/PPLOT2/PLPOS rewrite, T12). Each case now drives a bare DataFrame through the shared data_frame runner. The former Simulation wrapper used a minimal Normal model, but Numerics v2.2.0 parameter validation rejects its dummy draw for these deliberately small 1-2 observation scenarios. No estimator or distribution behavior is needed to test plotting positions.

assertions.note: C# Test_PlottingPositions_ValueBelowOwnThreshold_UsesCensoredBranch: an explicit value below its own covering threshold is classified as censored, not by a globally sorted band.

C# Test_PlottingPositions_AggregateThresholdCounts_AffectRanks: three left censored placeholders, one finite detection, and one right censored placeholder give detection probability 2/(2+3). The finite detection ranks before the right censored placeholder.
C# Test_PlottingPositions_OutsideThresholdWindow_IsDetected: an observation outside every threshold window is detected regardless of magnitude relative to an unrelated finite threshold.
